suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Windshield with calibration
suggested_services.example: The main story: a $588 windshield with calibration at the shop. Nothing is taken to book, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up. On an insurance job the shop bills the insurer, and Alex pays any share at the counter.

suggested_services.name: Windshield with calibration, in the driveway
suggested_services.example: The main story: a $588 windshield with calibration in Alex's driveway. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee. Alex's insurer pays, and Sam bills it himself, so Rosie sends no bill.

suggested_services.name: Windshield with calibration, in the driveway
suggested_services.example: The same windshield paid by Alex, or the share an insurer leaves to Alex. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee, and Rosie texts the bill after DONE.

services_listed_in_profession_file.name: Chip repair
services_listed_in_profession_file.price: one price by the number of chips (the example shop: $79 for the first, $20 each extra)
services_listed_in_profession_file.length: about 30 minutes; the car can be driven right after
services_listed_in_profession_file.before: mobile: a card saved for the trip fee; at the shop: nothing taken
services_listed_in_profession_file.after: billed to the customer's insurer, or the bill Rosie texts, or at the counter

services_listed_in_profession_file.name: Windshield, aftermarket glass
services_listed_in_profession_file.price: set by the car's year, make and model, from the shop's list (the example: a 2021 RAV4, $389)
services_listed_in_profession_file.length: about 75 minutes to fit, then the glue maker's safe drive-away time before the car moves (the example: 60 minutes)
services_listed_in_profession_file.before: mobile: a card saved for the trip fee; at the shop: nothing taken
services_listed_in_profession_file.after: billed to the customer's insurer, or the bill Rosie texts, or at the counter

services_listed_in_profession_file.name: Windshield, the carmaker's own glass (OEM)

services_listed_in_profession_file.length: as above; a special order, so the earliest time is 3 business days out

services_listed_in_profession_file.name: Camera calibration (lane-keeping, auto-braking)
services_listed_in_profession_file.price: one price, always its own line on a windshield for a car with a camera (the example: $199)
services_listed_in_profession_file.length: about 45 minutes, after the safe drive-away time, on a level spot

services_listed_in_profession_file.name: Side or back glass
services_listed_in_profession_file.price: set by the car; the owner OKs each one first

services_listed_in_profession_file.name: Mobile service

before_times: How big is the damage, and where: a chip smaller than a quarter, a crack under 6 inches, or bigger? Is it in the driver's view?
Does the car have lane-keeping or auto-braking? Yes, no or not sure
Insurance or paying yourself? Only the insurer's name goes through the AI
Which glass: aftermarket, or the carmaker's own (each with its price and earliest day)
For a mobile job: home or work, and the town
after_time: Where the car will be parked: a driveway, a garage or a lot; covered or open; flat
Where the keys will be if nobody is at the car
A stick-on toll tag on the glass?
secure_page_only: The street address and the parking spot
The VIN (a photo of the door sticker)
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult: the car's owner, or someone the owner lets book it; for a teen's car, a parent books and says yes to prices

safety_and_stop_words.stop_action: 'Call 911' first; no booking until everyone is safe

prep: Leave the keys where the glass tech can get them, or bring them
A stick-on toll tag can't move to new glass: plan for a new one
For a mobile job: park on flat ground, under a roof if rain is likely

staff.licenses_or_certificates: each glass tech's license, where the state licenses glass workers
staff.supervision: an apprentice works only with a licensed glass tech, where the state's rules require it
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs insurance checks, side and back glass, and every fee
staff.stand_in: only someone with the same skill; calibration only by a tech trained on the target kit; the customer is asked first

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult: the car's owner, or someone the owner lets book it; for a teen's car, a parent books and says yes to prices
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts about a teen's car go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: mobile: the code at the car, as at any door; with nobody at the car (keys at a front desk), no code: DONE with a photo. At the shop: the code at the counter when the car is left
visit.done: DONE (or READY at the shop) once the safe drive-away time has passed and the calibration passed; the report goes with the ready text
visit.before_work: photos of the car all round; the new glass checked against the car's features, like the camera bracket; a look under the moldings for rust

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: if: where the state registers repair shops that do glass work, or licenses auto glass workers
license.who: both: the shop, and each glass tech where the state licenses them
ask: The shop's repair-shop registration number, where the state has one
Each glass tech's auto glass license, where the state licenses glass workers
A glazing license for home glass, where the state's rules require one
license.insurance: garage liability and cover for customers' cars, as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: The insurance claim number or policy
The street address and parking spot, except to the glass tech on the job
